correctness.rationale: Uniform independent parent P_t in {1,...,t-1} yields Pr(Y_j=1)=(j-1)/(n-1), Y_1=0. The off-diagonal cross-covariance of D_i with Y_j telescopes to ((j-1)/(n-1))*(1/(max(i,j)-1)-1/(n-1)), i != j >= relevant, while D_jY_j=0 yields diagonal -Pr(Y_j) sum_{t=j}^{n-1}1/t. Row summation gives Cov(D_1,L)=(n-2)/(2(n-1)) and for nonroot i Cov(D_i,L)=((n-i)(n-3))/(2(n-1)^2)-(i-1)/(n-1) sum_{t=i}^{n-1} 1/t. Exact discrete second difference 1/[i(n-1)]>0 and last nonroot point negative while endpoint a_{n,n}=0 imply one ordered sign crossing even allowing zero/empty positive block. Harmonic sums converge to f(x)=(1-x)/2+x log x, uniquely crossing zero at alpha approximately .284668. Fresh independent parent-product enumeration of every recursive tree for n=2..8 verified 203 exact rational cross-covariance entries; not an infinite proof.

The formula is a reusable structural finite and limiting invariant, not a table extrapolation.
